_why: Exact differences a restart onto the other version shows that no same-version golden can, keyed <cell file>@<restart after tick>@<old_new|new_old>; each must explain a difference in its own case (test_host_cross_version.py). Reviewed with the PR that adds them and cleared after it merges. 2026-11-17 (the lifecycle matrix PR): a chronology that ended while the broker was away is now recorded when the broker returns; rolled back to the old host after that, the old host's first-tick job list reads the row the new host recorded (delivered, its counts and folder) where the old host's own restart reads the row it never recorded (running).
